summary.title: Enlight | Learn to code by building projects.
summary.one_liner: Enlight is an educational platform offering cohort-based development courses, such as a two-week Figma prototyping course and a two-week web development course built around projects.
keywords: learn to code by building projects
takeaways: Enlight runs cohort-based development courses with a community and accountability component.
A listed course teaches building high-fidelity clickable prototypes in Figma in two weeks (starting March 21st, 2021).
A listed course teaches web development by building three projects in two weeks (starting April 4th, 2021).
The platform reports more than 12,000 learners.
summary.summary: The page is the landing page for Enlight, an educational platform for cohort-based development courses. It promotes a supportive community and accountability alongside the courses and states that more than 12,000 learners have joined. Two courses are listed: a two-week Figma course on clickable prototypes starting March 21st, 2021, and a two-week web development course building three projects, starting April 4th, 2021. The page text is mostly marketing and gives no details on curriculum, pricing, or format beyond these points.
